answer: Voting weight grows with the square root of locked POA, and stake must age 20 epochs before it counts, so splitting funds across fakes shrinks power: ten accounts holding 100 each carry 100 units, one holding 1,000 carries 31.6. Like a garden where each extra weed starves the rest, splitting loses. Even a nebula of sockpuppets, or a karst maze of shell wallets, is exposed because validators recompute weights from on-chain locks.
